specifications.Assembly Instructions Description: Lay out the tent body and locate the two aluminum poles. Connect the poles to form a cross shape. Insert the pole ends into the grommets at each corner of the tent body. Secure the poles with the attached clips, creating a freestanding structure. Attach the rain fly to the tent body using the buckles and adjust the tension as needed. Stake the tent to the ground using the provided aluminum stakes for stability and additional weather protection.
